author: Cip
body:
1) Add objectives to the stats page where kills are shown like on the OCN stats pages. Some people would complain that it's copying OCN but it's genuinely just common sense. 

2) Make the leaderboards easier to understand?? Maybe just make a "most wools" leaderboard and a "most kills leaderboard" , because I really think that would add more competition than there currently is. Having a leaderboard for each specific server makes no sense and they're somewhat confusing to me as a new player, even though I have some experience on objective based servers (OCN).
